label: 1-2 steps after a j input, original phase (t=2..6)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the one or two steps right after the letter j was input. It is strongest one step after j (prev_tok=j gives 16x lift and 64% of mass) and weaker two steps after. It is position-gated: silent at t=0, very weak at t=1 (e.g. j j at t=0-1 gives about 0.01), peaks at t=3-4, fades by t=6, and is essentially never active at t>=7. Repeated j (j j j) gives the largest activations, up to about 1.0 of max. It never fires in the copy phase and only weakly at the delimiter. The low-activation tail (about 8% of mass) is scattered mid-sequence firing with no j nearby. Dev: P 0.83, R 0.74, F1 0.78, mass recall 0.92.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=j (+8.59), prev2_tok=j (+7.95), t=3 & prev_tok=j (+6.16), prev3_tok=j (+5.03), t=5 & prev_tok=j (+3.83), t=4 (+3.33). Lower it: phase=2 (-9.96), orig_idx=-1 (-8.03), t=8 (-7.99), prev_tok=x (-7.33).
